name: Starter math profile regression cases
description: 20 hand-authored fictional metadata examples labeled for the bundled mathematics profile. Includes keyword ambiguity, a negation trap and a relevant paraphrase without configured keywords. Labels are design judgments, not independently annotated research data. Do not report these metrics as real-world accuracy.

paper.title: Strong convergence of random matrices
paper.abstract: We study operator norm convergence for matrix products under a finite fourth moment.

paper.title: Free probability and spectral approximation
paper.abstract: We compare spectra of random matrices with free probability limits.

paper.title: Universality for non-Hermitian random matrices
paper.abstract: We compare spectral statistics under moment assumptions.

paper.title: Largest eigenvalues of independent Gaussian arrays
paper.abstract: We study the limiting edge fluctuations of large symmetric arrays whose entries are independent Gaussian variables above the diagonal.

paper.title: Warm starts for spiked tensor PCA
paper.abstract: We analyze alternating power iteration and tensor estimation in a high-dimensional inference problem.

paper.title: Statistical limits of tensor decomposition
paper.abstract: We establish estimation bounds for a noisy low-rank tensor model.

paper.title: Mixing time of a Markov chain
paper.abstract: We bound the spectral gap of heat bath dynamics.

paper.title: Sliding-window occupation counts
paper.abstract: Conditionally resampled occupation counts define a Markov chain with a quantitative spectral gap.

paper.title: Poincaré inequalities for conditional resampling
paper.abstract: We derive a functional inequality controlling convergence to equilibrium.

paper.title: The KLS conjecture and stochastic localization
paper.abstract: We study concentration of measure for log-concave distributions.

paper.title: Transport inequalities on the Boolean cube
paper.abstract: We relate reverse heat couplings to concentration inequalities.

paper.title: Spectral gaps in photonic crystals
paper.abstract: We tune a photonic band structure and measure the optical spectral gap.

paper.title: Gap engineering in semiconductor films
paper.abstract: We compare material band gaps at different temperatures.

paper.title: Sliding window detection for aerial images
paper.abstract: A sliding window image detector processes large photographs.

paper.title: A generic prediction model
paper.abstract: We train a neural model on a supervised classification dataset.

paper.title: Warm start schedules for neural training
paper.abstract: We compare warm start strategies for a language classifier.

paper.title: Tensor decomposition for video compression
paper.abstract: We use tensor decomposition to compress video frames and measure reconstruction quality.

paper.title: Universality of online social patterns
paper.abstract: We describe universality across social communication networks without spectral analysis.

paper.title: Terminology in technical abstracts
paper.abstract: This linguistic study counts vocabulary usage. We do not study random matrices or free probability; these are merely example phrases in a writing survey.

paper.title: A renewal identity
paper.abstract: We establish an elementary identity for a renewal process with no result about the configured research topics.
